notes.title: DumbBots is live!
notes.notes:
The full release DumbBots is [i]finally[/i] live and available to play (albeit later than I had originally hoped). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232890/DumbBots

If you're interested in learning some basic programming concepts, or teaching your child to learn about programming, and doing it in an entertaining way - give DumbBots a buy and try. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668097/b4070e91fd7728c60e432d9dc63f383e7f8ffa13.gif[/img]

DumbBots also supports making custom scenarios. So if you're a teacher who wants to challenge your class, or someone who wants to make coding challenges for your friends - this game let's you do that.

notes.title: DumbBots: Hello World
notes.notes:
[b]DumbBots: Hello World[/b] is the FREE demo for DumbBots.

The tutorial levels have been made freely available to provide a taste of what's to come, as well as a basic introduction to some coding principles for anyone interested in picking up the craft. 

And it's available to play NOW. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668097/3e6daf5833954808582c59a2386e632797e01d1b.gif[/img]
